The pod's own copy now guards on pg_isready; the durable fix is this tree's retro output in docs/solutions/testing/a-browser-harness-in-an-issue-pod-lives-on-the-issue-volume-INFRA-43.md and the port-holder document, by the controller's decision rather than a filed issue.

The Inbox leg's two checks remain one-shot document.elementFromPoint reads with no settle; they passed in every repeat of all three rounds, and all six recorded CI failures of this row were the Conversation assertion.
